summary: The flow stores a plaintext username:password string in an HTTP cookie (CWE-315). The feature is preserving an 'auth' cookie keyed off the credentials. I fix the sink in Servlet_54e by hashing the data with SHA-512 (MessageDigest is already imported) and storing the hex digest instead of the plaintext credentials, so no readable secret is persisted client-side while the cookie is still set for valid inputs.
